verdict.rationale: Rev AI publishes a pricing page with per-minute pricing for at least one model (Whisper Large at $0.005 per minute), so an agent could estimate the base cost from audio duration before submitting a job. The evidence shows no itemized add-on prices (e.g., for sentiment, summarization, translation, or human transcription), no Reverb ASR per-minute rate, and no machine-readable pricing source. Missing for 10: itemized add-on/feature pricing, per-minute rates for all ASR models and human transcription, machine-readable or API-accessible pricing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can compute the cost of a transcription job before submitting it, because pricing is published per audio minute or hour with add-on prices itemized

citations.quote: Free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR
